mapper.select: SELECT m1.id, m1.main_menu_name as name, m1.main_menu_redirect as url, FROM main_menu as m1 WHERE m1.main_menu_status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO main_menu (main_menu_name, main_menu_desc, main_menu_status, main_menu_redirect) VALUES (#{main_menu_name}, #{main_menu_desc}, #{main_menu_status}, #{main_menu_redirect})
